These notes collect the concepts needed before the experiments and paper reviews make sense: which physical process cloud seeding targets, and what steps take an aerosol particle to a cloud droplet and a cloud droplet to a raindrop. They are rewritten from textbooks and lab-meeting presentations.

Each note writes the equation first, reads it in words, unpacks it term by term, and ends with its physical meaning. The same concepts reappear in the [PySDM](pysdm.qmd) experiments, the [WRF](wrf.qmd) simulations, and the [Article Review](article-review.qmd) posts.
